episode_summary: Julia Hurley shares her journey from being voted out of a company to building a successful real estate business. She emphasizes the importance of resilience, providing value in networking, and effective lead generation strategies like open houses and door knocking. The episode offers actionable insights for re-engaging past clients and leveraging personal connections.
